title: Teaching a Parent to Use a Smartphone
paragraphs: Ketika ayahnya menerima ponsel pintar pertamanya sebagai hadiah ulang tahun, Adnan segera menyadari bahwa tugas dasar seperti mengirim pesan teks perlu dijelaskan perlahan, langkah demi langkah, beberapa kali.

Ayahnya, merasa malu karena membutuhkan begitu banyak bantuan, bercanda bahwa ia sudah mengoperasikan mesin rumit di tempat kerja selama tiga puluh tahun tapi entah bagaimana tidak bisa mengoperasikan layar ponsel sederhana.

Adnan dengan sabar membuat panduan tertulis dengan langkah-langkah besar dan sederhana untuk tugas yang paling sering dilakukan ayahnya, seperti menelepon anggota keluarga dan memeriksa cuaca setiap pagi.
Dalam sebulan, ayahnya dengan percaya diri mengirim pesan suara dan foto ke grup obrolan keluarga, dengan bangga menunjukkan kemampuan yang tampak mustahil baginya hanya beberapa minggu sebelumnya.
answerKey: When his father received his first smartphone as a birthday gift, Adnan quickly realized that basic tasks like sending a text message needed to be explained slowly, step by step, several times. His father, feeling embarrassed about needing so much help, joked that he had managed complex machinery at work for thirty years but somehow could not manage a simple phone screen. Adnan patiently created a written guide with large, simple steps for the tasks his father used most often, like calling family members and checking the weather each morning. Within a month, his father was confidently sending voice messages and photos to the family group chat, proudly showing off skills that had seemed impossible to him just weeks earlier.
